post.title: Why do 99% of requests run fast while a few experience massive latency spikes? | Tail Latency
post.subtitle:
Why do ninety-nine percent of your users get lightning fast responses, while a few experience painful multi-second delays? 🛠️

Learn how to master Solving the Tail Latency Problem in Microservices in this quick breakdown.

📖 Read the full guide here:
https://www.abstractalgorithms.dev/

In this Short:
- Why do 99% of requests run fast while a few experience massive latency spikes?
- Average metrics hide spikes; p99 latency exposes GC pauses and contention.
- Microservice fan-out amplifies tail latency across dependent calls.
- Speculative request hedging eliminates tail latency in distributed systems.
